title: Objective
description: One user objective. The default delivery unit: one objective = one PR unless an exception in core/policies/delivery.md applies.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the file was written against.

id.description: Objective slug. Also the directory name under .dev-files/objectives/.

base_branch.description: Branch the objective is cut from and delivered back into.

integration_branch.description: Branch worker branches merge into. Conventionally objective/<id>.

tasks.description: Task ids belonging to this objective, in planned order.

exception_reason.description: Required when strategy is not single-pr. Must name one of the enumerated exceptions in core/policies/delivery.md.

auto_merge.description: Policy, not invariant. Absent means: follow repository/user configuration.

provider_hints.description: Optional, advisory. Preferred providers per role; provider is metadata and never part of branch or path identity.
